description: Read-only. Lists the trades supported and tells you whether a city in Canada or the United States is covered, and whether we already have a ranked provider shortlist there (pre_ranked) or will source providers when the request arrives (live_sourced). Call this before request_quotes if you are unsure the trade or city is supported. It does not create a request or contact anyone.

city.description: City or municipality, for example 'Mississauga' or 'Austin'.

region.description: Province or state, for example 'ON' or 'TX'.

trade.description: Home-service trade. Use 'other' with trade_detail for anything not listed.

name: get_coverage
title: Check home-service coverage
